Title II, ACC-HHS-ACF-TOTAL -- printed as 'Total, Administration for Children and Families' 51,897,205 [FY 2025 Estimate], PDF p.356 (printed p.352). Source: H.Rept. 119-271's 'FY 2025 Estimate' column, which the report defines (pp.319-320) as 'FY 2025 Operating Plans and other available information'; FY2025 was a full-year continuing resolution (P.L. 119-4, Full-Year Continuing Appropriations Act, 2025, division A). P.L. 119-4 sec. 1109(a): amounts necessary to maintain program levels -- no dollar level in law; this is the report's estimate. Parts the law does set: P.L. 119-4 sec. 1908(4), 139 Stat. 33: ACF Children and Families Services Programs, '"$0" for "$40,011,000"'.
